svg.text: Thinking models
Classical decision frames, each rendered as a grammar rather than a prompt. Reach for one when
you know the shape of the thinking you want.
/10-10-10-dtd [decision or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Judge a decision at ten minutes, ten months and ten years, naming the horizon where the
sign flips
/5-whys-dtd [problem or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Ask why until the cause is actionable: three to five links, each answering the last, and
an intervention that names its recurrence check
/eisenhower-matrix-dtd [tasks or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Every item in exactly one of do, schedule, delegate, eliminate, with the next action a
do-first item owes
/first-principles-dtd [problem or leave blank for current context; add --no-gate to skip the assumption gate]
29 laws
Break down to fundamentals and rebuild from base truths; every assumption gets an origin
and a verdict, every conclusion names the truths it stands on
/inversion-dtd [goal or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Write the failure recipe first: each way to guarantee defeat, its likelihood and damage,
and the rule that avoids it
/occams-razor-dtd [situation or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Count the assumptions behind each explanation; the winner fits every fact with the
fewest unsupported ones
/one-thing-dtd [goal or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
The single action that makes the rest easier or unnecessary, chosen from named
candidates and doable within the hour
/opportunity-cost-dtd [choice or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
What the choice spends and the single best alternative it forecloses, in one unit, with
a yes, partial or no
/pareto-dtd [topic or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Find the vital few: rank every factor by impact, cut at a declared count, and name what
you will ignore
/second-order-dtd [action or leave blank for current context; add --no-gate to skip the chain gate]
29 laws
Think through consequences of consequences as a declared causal chain; every effect has
an order, a cause, a sign, a horizon and a confidence, and loops are named
/swot-dtd [subject or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats sorted by control, plus four moves that
each pair an inside with an outside
/via-negativa-dtd [situation or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
Improve by removing: each candidate with the impact of its removal, what passed the keep
test, what to refuse next
